ports.note: Two tables in, one out: the rows of the second under the first, columns lined up by name. Both must have the same value column and unit; a key column only one has is empty on the other's rows.

ontology.note: No ontology mapping yet. The receipt names how many rows came from each table and every column only one of them has.

changes.description: THE YEARS BEING STACKED, said in the step's own sentence, and one period per source carried on the stacked table (experiment 230). The population example stacks a 2025 model under a 2022 census and nothing said they were three years apart. Deliberately UNLIKE the unit difference beside it: stacking counts of people under counts of houses is refused, because it is wrong; stacking 2022 under 2025 is said, and the rows are stacked. Silent where no table states a period -- the sentence would otherwise appear on every run and mean only that nobody has said anything -- and where some do, the ones that do not are named, because then the silence is a gap. The WIDEST gap is reported: three tables of 1984, 2022 and 2025 are 41 years apart at their extremes, and "3 years apart" would be true of a pair and false of the stack.

evidence.note:

THE YEARS (experiment 230, 2026-11-24). Unit tested: all-silent says nothing; one year counted one way says nothing; a 2025 model under a 2022 census says three years apart and names both; three tables report 41 and not 3; the same year counted two ways is two periods; a silent table among stated ones is named; and the stacked table carries one period per source, labelled as the source column labels each row.
